cards.card_text: On to the next feast: count off seven weeks from the day the sickle first hits the standing grain, then celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD.
cards.verse_text: You are to count off seven weeks from the time you first put the sickle to the standing grain.
cards.snippet: …to count off seven weeks from the time you first put the sickle to the standing grain.

cards.verse_text: When you enter your neighbor’s grainfield, you may pluck the heads of grain with your hand, but you must not put a sickle to your neighbor’s grain.
cards.snippet: …heads of grain with your hand, but you must not put a sickle to your neighbor’s grain.

cards.card_text: Then comes another command: cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time.
cards.verse_text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time.
cards.snippet: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time.

cards.card_text: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe, and trample the grapes, for the winepress is full.
cards.verse_text: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe.
cards.snippet: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe.

cards.verse_text: And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
cards.snippet: And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

cards.verse_text: And I looked and saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
cards.snippet: …of Man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.

cards.card_text: Then another angel comes out of the temple and cries out in a loud voice to the One on the cloud: swing Your sickle and reap.
cards.verse_text: Then another angel came out of the temple, crying out in a loud voice to the One seated on the cloud, “Swing Your sickle and reap, because the time has come to harvest, for the crop of the earth is ripe.”

cards.card_text: The One seated on the cloud swings His sickle over the earth.
cards.verse_text: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
cards.snippet: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

cards.card_text: Then another angel comes out of the temple in heaven, and he has a sharp sickle too.
cards.verse_text: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
cards.snippet: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

cards.card_text: He calls out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle.
cards.verse_text: Still another angel, with authority over the fire, came from the altar and called out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, “Swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.”

cards.verse_text: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
